doc.brief: The granularity for queries about the text contents of a [`AccessibleText`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleText) implementation.

The granularity for queries about the text contents of a [`AccessibleText`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleText)

sentence.brief: Use the boundary between sentences, starting from the beginning of the current sentence and ending at the beginning of the next sentence
